title: fix(release): leave a current-series field written ahead of its GA cut for that GA's own version run
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DN8SjB9bVtNocaFMtyNzUcM)_

Fixes #25408

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

A code PR on one file, `scripts/sync-release-index-currency.mjs` (+261 / -20). It touches no `content/docs/releases/**` file, no workflow, no package and no `.claude/**`.

## What changed

The rewriter treated any `current series:` field that did not name its major's newest GA as stale, and stamped it to that GA with the run's date. A field written by hand ahead of a GA cut names a NEWER version than the newest GA. So every version pass that was not that GA's own moved it backwards, under a date that belongs to neither release. Such passes are an rc cut, a run with nothing new, and a lower version's GA run.

Now:

- **`aheadOfNewestGa(named, newest)`** is true when the field names a newer version of the same major. It is a numeric triple compare, so 17.10.0 is ahead of 17.9.0. A different major is never ahead, because no run of this major can make that field true. A version that is not `x.y.z` throws, because either default would bring back a defect.
- **`rewriteStatusField`** returns null for such a field on every run, with the GA-run flag set or not. So a lower version's GA run (an 18.0.1 patch) also leaves an 18.1.0 field alone.
- **`currencyVerdict({ indexText, changelogText })`** returns `{ findings, deferred }`. It is the gate's own `indexCurrencyFindings` for every major, except a major whose field is ahead of the cut, which becomes a deferral instead of a finding. `currencyFindings` is now its `findings`, and `syncIndex` returns `deferred` as well.
- **`main()`** prints one line per deferral and exits 0. On the measured shape the line reads: "v18: (current series: 18.1.0, released 2026-10-21) left as written — 18.1.0 is newer than v18's newest GA in packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md (18.0.0), so the field was written ahead of the 18.1.0 cut. Only 18.1.0's own version run can date it, and it will; rewriting it now would move it back to 18.0.0 under a date that belongs to neither release. If 18.1.0 will not ship, correct the field by hand. check-release-section-coverage reports it until then." The "nothing rewritten" line no longer claims that every entry names the newest GA when a deferral exists.
- The header gains a section, "A field written AHEAD of the cut", and a bullet under "What it deliberately does NOT rewrite".

A field BEHIND the newest GA is stamped forward exactly as before. The GA's own version run still re-dates the field (the path #25407 added), now starting from the pre-written version.

## Why exit 0 and not a stop

The dispatch allowed either, "whichever the existing exit ladder supports". The ladder's exit 1 is the loud stop for shapes that need a hand-written sentence: a contradicted "final release:" or a missing parenthetical. It fails `pnpm run version`. That would fail every `cut-rc.yml` cut ("Version the workspace", line 473) and every `version-pr` refresh (release.yml lines 561 and 939) from the day a field is pre-written until its GA. No sentence improves that state, and the GA's own run resolves it. So the field is deferred and the run says why.

The deferral is per major. A refused shape on another major in the same index still reaches the verdict and stops the run (pinned in Control J).

The gate is unchanged and still reports the field: advisory on `main` without `--strict`, and red under `--strict` in `release-coverage-patrol.yml`. Turning on `--strict` anywhere else is a workflow edit and outside this card.

## Proof

**Throwaway repositories, before and after.** Each repository holds `scripts/`, the spec CHANGELOG (newest GA 18.0.0) and the release index from `origin/main` `0b8dbea`. The v18 field was changed to `(current series: 18.1.0, released 2026-10-21)` and committed as `HEAD`. Then the CHANGELOG was changed as each pass would change it, and `node scripts/sync-release-index-currency.mjs` was run on 2026-10-23:

| Shape | `origin/main` `0b8dbea` | this branch |
|:--|:--|:--|
| nothing pending | `→ (current series: 18.0.0, released 2026-10-23)`, exit 0 | left as written (the notice quoted above), exit 0, `git diff` empty |
| `## 18.1.0-rc.0` added (an rc cut) | `→ (current series: 18.0.0, released 2026-10-23)`, exit 0 | left as written, exit 0, `git diff` empty |
| `## 18.1.0` added (18.1.0's own version run) | `→ (current series: 18.1.0, released 2026-10-23) — re-dated: …`, exit 0 | the same |

**Self-test** (`pnpm check:release-index-currency-sync`, exit 0): "OK self-test: 75 cases pass", up from 58. The new battery **Control J** has 17 cases and is floored; the roster floor moves from 9 to 10. It pins:

- An ahead field is left byte-identical on a run with nothing to version, on an rc cut of that very version, and on the GA run of a lower version (17.3.1). It is refused at the field level with or without the GA-run flag.
- The other direction on the same run: a field behind the newest GA (17.2.0) is still stamped forward, version and date.
- The compare is numeric (17.10.0 against 17.9.0, patch-level, a version against itself). A v17 field naming 18.4.0 is not ahead and is stamped as stale. A version that is not `x.y.z` is refused.
- The gate's own `indexCurrencyFindings` still reports the field, while the verdict carries it as one deferral and no finding. A refused "final release:" on v16 in the same index still reaches the verdict.
- The notice names the field, the newest GA, whose run dates it and the remedy, and carries no tracker number.
- On 17.4.0's own version run the field is re-dated and nothing is deferred.
- End to end through `syncIndex` on checkout-shaped git repositories, on the measured 18.1.0 shape: no write and the file byte-identical with nothing pending and on an `18.1.0-rc.0` cut; re-dated on disk on 18.1.0's own run.

**Ablations.** Each was applied to the committed head, the self-test re-run, and the file restored (`git hash-object` identical):

| Removed | Self-test |
|:--|:--|
| the rewriter's refusal of an ahead field | exit 1, 6 Control J failures |
| the verdict's deferral | exit 1, 5 failures |
| numeric compare, replaced by a string compare | exit 1, 1 failure |
| the same-major guard | exit 1, 1 failure |
| the refusal of a version that is not `x.y.z` | exit 1, 1 failure |

**Live tree:** `node scripts/sync-release-index-currency.mjs` prints "every in-scope entry in content/docs/releases/index.mdx (v16, v17, v18) already names the newest GA release of its major … nothing rewritten", exit 0, and the tree stays clean.

## Gates

At `6d07608` (base `0b8dbea`), `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 33 commands for the one path. Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all 33 exited 0. `--ran` reconciles: "✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 33 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 33 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 33 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". The script-specific families among them include `check:release-index-currency-sync`, `check-scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check-self-test-wired` and `check-self-test-workflow-commands` (each in both modes), `check:entry-guard`, `check:nul-bytes` and `check:pm-dispatch-gates`. `pnpm exec eslint scripts/sync-release-index-currency.mjs` exits 0.

The branch then merged `origin/main` `ea33919`. None of the incoming commits touches this script, the gate it imports, `git-env.mjs` or `invoked-as.mjs`, and the v18 field on `main` still reads `(current series: 18.0.0, released 2026-10-20)`. At the merged head `9697865` the self-test (75 cases), the live run and the three-shape measurement above were run again with the same results. The pre-push `check:commit-card-trailers` passed on both pushes.

`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/project-thread-zhlg06`: "0 of 1 path(s) hit the register (7 surfaces govern objectstack). ✅ NOT governed", 281 changed lines (≤ 3000).

No package source moves, so no package `test` or `typecheck` is owed. CI owns `test:repo`, Test Core, the type-check lanes and `pnpm lint`; this PR's check-runs answer them.

**`skip-changeset`.** The file lives in the private root package (`"private": true`), and `scripts/` is in no published package's `files[]`. The label rides the create.

## Acceptance notes

- A field naming a GA that never ships (the series closes first) is deferred on every run, and the gate keeps reporting it. The notice names that case and its remedy, a correction by hand. Whether a planned GA was abandoned is a human judgement, so it is not mechanised.
- A `final release:` field written ahead of its cut is not deferred. It is a refused shape and still stops the run, as before. No such field is in the corpus, and it is outside this card.
- Follow-up, named and not done: running `check-release-section-coverage --strict` on PRs is a workflow edit (Tier H) and outside this card.
- The attribution block's first line is an HTML comment that the session requires, and `os-dev.md` forbids HTML comments in GitHub text. Same shape as #25407; reported as a deviation.
- The branch is the harness-pinned `claude/project-thread-zhlg06`. The claim (comment `6368342248`) records it as the identity.
